regions.name: Crystal Coast
regions.scope: Morehead City, Beaufort, and the Emerald Isle / Bogue Inlet shore when a source is local to those waters.

seasonal.title: Bogue Inlet Pier’s seasonal hours
seasonal.body: Bogue Inlet Pier says it closes for the season on Sunday, November 29, 2026, at 5 p.m., and reopens Friday, March 12, 2027. Season-pass holders and their guests may still use the pier in winter, according to the pier. This is the pier’s own schedule, not a catch report or a forecast of what will be biting.

regions.name: Hatteras

reports.title: Fishing Report 11-20

regions.name: Falls Lake
regions.scope: Falls Lake, Neuse River basin, Wake, Durham, and Granville counties. This is not Jordan Lake.

seasonal.title: 2026 warmwater stocking list
seasonal.body: Falls Lake does not appear on the 2026 NCWRC warmwater stocking list (page last modified February 20, 2026). This is a fact about the official list, not a catch report.

regions.name: Jordan Lake
regions.scope: Jordan Lake, Cape Fear basin, Chatham and Durham counties. This is not Falls Lake.

seasonal.title: 2026 warmwater stocking list
seasonal.body: Jordan Reservoir at Farrington Point appears on the 2026 NCWRC warmwater stocking list (page last modified February 20, 2026). That is a planned stocking notice, not a report of what is biting.
seasonal.scope: Jordan Reservoir, Farrington Point WRC boating access area

regions.name: Neuse River
regions.scope: The Neuse River from Falls Dam to Goldsboro (Wake, Johnston, and Wayne counties). This is not the lower tidal Neuse or the New Bern estuary. Kinston is not in this region.

seasonal.title: This stretch of the Neuse
seasonal.body: This page covers the Neuse from Falls Dam to Goldsboro only. Official stocking notes for the lower tidal river, including Pamlico County, are out of scope. Not a catch report.

dmf-proclamations.scope: Statewide coastal and joint fishing waters
dmf-proclamations.body: Official proclamations in effect. This is a rules list, not a catch report. Limits are linked, not restated here.

dmf-rec-guide.scope: Statewide coastal and joint fishing waters

ncwrc-baa.title: NCWRC boating access area closures
ncwrc-baa.body: Official full and partial ramp closures. Check the agency page before launching. This is an access notice, not a catch report.

ncwrc-inland-regs.title: 2026–27 Inland Fishing, Hunting & Trapping Regulations Digest
ncwrc-inland-regs.body: Official inland regulations digest. Linked, not restated. This is a seasonal official document, not a daily report.

falls-sra.body: Official park hours, access, and alerts. The park page has no fishing report.

jordan-sra.title: Jordan Lake State Recreation Area
jordan-sra.body: Official park hours, access, and alerts. The park page has no fishing report.

jordan-stocking.scope: Jordan Reservoir, Farrington Point WRC boating access area
